rules.description: State of charge stays between 5% and 95% of 40 MWh at all times (95% efficiency on charge, 89% on discharge).
Charge and discharge are each between 0 and 20 MW, never both in the same interval; grid import at most 20 MW.
While the substation works last, site export (solar + discharge - charge) must not exceed the amended 15 MW cap whenever the battery discharges.
The site may import from the grid (charging beyond solar output) only in intervals starting 01:00-04:45 local time.
The week starts at 50% state of charge and must end at no less than 50%.
State of charge is at least 20% at every moment between 16:00 and 20:00 local time each day.
On Thursday 25 March from 18:00 to 21:00, while the battery discharges, site export must not exceed the DSO's 10 MW limit.
The battery neither charges nor discharges on Monday 22 March from 08:00 to 20:00 (inverter maintenance).
